name: premium-pet-gamepass-configuration
description: Verify the three production premium-pet Game Pass IDs, live Roblox metadata, authoritative mappings, purchase affordances, and clean runtime without opening a purchase prompt.

steps.label: wait for premium catalog and UI

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local M=game:GetService('MarketplaceService') local cfg=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local expected={['Crimson Phoenix']={1948233870,79},['Storm Wyvern']={1948851823,169},['Celestial Guardian']={1947471788,349}} local rows={} local ids={} local ok=true for _,pet in ipairs(cfg.PremiumPets) do local e=expected[pet.name] local success,info=pcall(function() return M:GetProductInfoAsync(pet.gamePassId,Enum.InfoType.GamePass) end) local row={name=pet.name,id=pet.gamePassId,configuredPrice=pet.robux,lookup=success} if success then row.liveName=info.Name row.livePrice=info.PriceInRobux row.userBasePrice=info.UserBasePriceInRobux row.forSale=info.IsForSale row.match=info.Name==pet.name and (tonumber(info.PriceInRobux) or 0)>0 and info.IsForSale==true else row.error=tostring(info) row.match=false end row.config=e and pet.gamePassId==e[1] and pet.robux==e[2] or false ok=ok and row.config and row.match and not ids[pet.gamePassId] ids[pet.gamePassId]=true table.insert(rows,row) end local result={ok=ok and #rows==3,count=#rows,rows=rows} assert(result.ok,'premium pet pass metadata mismatch '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: live Roblox Game Pass identities and regional prices are available

Premium Pet Price',true) local detector=stand and stand:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('ClickDetector',true) local row={name=pet.name,id=pet.gamePassId,stand=stand~=nil,price=price~=nil,detector=detector~=nil,configured=stand and stand:GetAttribute('PurchaseConfigured')==true and stand:GetAttribute('PurchaseUnavailable')==false and price and price:GetAttribute('PurchaseConfigured')==true and price:GetAttribute('PurchaseUnavailable')==false} ok=ok and row.stand and row.price and row.detector and row.configured table.insert(rows,row) end local result={ok=ok and #rows==3,count=#rows,rows=rows} assert(result.ok,'premium pet world purchase mapping mismatch '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: all premium pet world stands expose configured authoritative purchase paths

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local M=game:GetService('MarketplaceService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD') local a=g:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation') local cfg=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) assert(a:Invoke('OpenTab','Fists')==true,'Shop host did not open') assert(a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Premium')==true,'Premium Shop page did not open') local shop=g.GameMenu:WaitForChild('FunctionalHeroShop') local function cardFor(pet) return shop:FindFirstChild(pet.name..'ShopCard',true) end local function buttonFor(pet) local card=cardFor(pet) return card and card:FindFirstChild(pet.name..'Action',true) end local deadline=os.clock()+8 local allResolved=false repeat task.wait(.1) allResolved=true for _,pet in ipairs(cfg.PremiumPets) do local button=buttonFor(pet) allResolved=allResolved and button~=nil and button:GetAttribute('RegionalPriceResolved')==true end until allResolved or os.clock()>=deadline local root=workspace:WaitForChild('PunchWallRPG') local rows={} local ok=allResolved and g.GameMenu.Visible and shop.Visible and a:Invoke('Snapshot').shopPage=='Premium' for _,pet in ipairs(cfg.PremiumPets) do local card=cardFor(pet) local button=buttonFor(pet) local priceLabel=card and card:FindFirstChild('Price',true) local scroll=shop:FindFirstChild('ShopCatalogScroll') if scroll and card then local y=scroll.CanvasPosition.Y+card.AbsolutePosition.Y-scroll.AbsolutePosition.Y scroll.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,math.clamp(y,0,math.max(0,scroll.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y-scroll.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y))) task.wait(.1) end local lookup,info=pcall(function() return M:GetProductInfoAsync(pet.gamePassId,Enum.InfoType.GamePass) end) local livePrice=lookup and tonumber(info.PriceInRobux) or 0 local displayed=button and tonumber(button:GetAttribute('DisplayedRobuxPrice')) or 0 local stand=root:FindFirstChild(pet.name..' Premium Pet Stand',true) local price=root:FindFirstChild(pet.name..' Premium Pet Price',true) local worldText='' if price then for _,d in ipairs(price:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('TextLabel') and d.Name=='Subtitle' then worldText..=' '..string.upper(d.Text or '') end end end local row={card=card~=nil,identity=card and card:GetAttribute('GamePassId')==pet.gamePassId and button and button:GetAttribute('GamePassId')==pet.gamePassId,bound=button and button:GetAttribute('ShopActionBound')==true,priceText=priceLabel and priceLabel.Text or '',renderedPrice=priceLabel and priceLabel.Visible and priceLabel.TextFits and tonumber(priceLabel.Text)==livePrice,name=pet.name,id=pet.gamePassId,livePrice=livePrice,displayed=displayed,actionText=button and button.Text or '',found=button~=nil,active=button and button.Active==true,selectable=button and button.Selectable==true,configured=button and button:GetAttribute('PurchaseConfigured')==true and button:GetAttribute('PurchaseUnavailable')==false,resolved=button and button:GetAttribute('RegionalPriceResolved')==true,price=displayed==livePrice,world=stand and price and stand:GetAttribute('RegionalPriceResolved')==true and price:GetAttribute('RegionalPriceResolved')==true and tonumber(price:GetAttribute('DisplayedRobuxPrice'))==livePrice and worldText:find('R$ '..livePrice,1,true)~=nil} ok=ok and lookup and row.card and row.identity and row.bound and row.renderedPrice and row.found and row.active and row.selectable and row.configured and row.resolved and row.price and row.world table.insert(rows,row) end local result={ok=ok and #rows==3,count=#rows,rows=rows} assert(result.ok,'premium pet regional UI configuration mismatch '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)
